always_protected: old predictions or fit state without permitted training lineage

conditions.query: base_query with eval_counts_heldin replaced by the protected within-condition donor trace; recipient IDs, units, bins and condition unchanged
conditions.state: Training-only state may be reused with original charged lineage. Every query-dependent readout, adaptation state, cache and prediction must be produced from this shuffled pool; no intact neural-adapted state or neural prediction cache is visible. All reference inference and arbitrary tools consume the shuffled pool. R0/R1/R2 deterministic context outputs may be identical with explicit lineage.

conditions.forbidden: All observed-neuron count arrays, observations, latent factors, neural-covariate state and neural predictions; nuisance states trained solely from allowed withheld training labels remain permitted.
conditions.paper_code: same A/B sources, with no empirical neural payloads or target-derived outcome comments

conditions.forbidden: All trial/time-resolved training counts, all condition IDs, all observed-neuron counts/state and non-R0 reference states/predictions. Output axes remain required; arbitrary positive predictions may use paper priors but do not gain empirical time profiles.
conditions.paper_code: same A/B curated source and paper; no hidden empirical profiles

conditions.interpretation: Not anonymized biology: papers/code reveal domain. No domain-free or native-understanding inference.
conditions.paper_code: unchanged A/B; neutral task instruction framing alone

shuffle_recipe.limits: Singletons preserve alignment; m=2 uniquely invertible and m>2 may permit neural matching. Record group-size histogram/identity count in protected report, never call this information deletion or causal proof.
shuffle_recipe.mapping: For group rows r and random permutation p of 0..m-1, assign trace donor r[p[(j+1)%m]] to recipient r[p[j]] for j=0..m-1. For m=1 retain identity. One directed cycle ensures no fixed points for m>1. Same committed map across F/I,A/B and all five seeds.
shuffle_recipe.partition: Group recipient rows by public condition identity, order within each group by exact original query roster. Never use counts, labels, scores or outcomes to choose groups/map.

commitment_rule.donor_cycle: original query order; recipient group[order[j]] receives group[order[(j+1)%m]]; singleton identity
commitment_rule.planned_support_encoding: canonical UTF8 sorted-key compact finite JSON plus exactly one LF
commitment_rule.rng: NumPy Generator(PCG64), exact version pinned in commitment
commitment_rule.tuple_encoding: UTF8 compact finite JSON array ensure_ascii=False separators=(comma,colon) without LF

comparability: One changed diagnostic randomization identity, not a new scientific task or access arm.
The same seed need not match the superseded tuple. Reproducibility requires the selected tuple/version/support; never mix old and new results.
Paired comparability holds by one common committed map across all matched conditions; no condition/model-specific map or map tuning.
Singletons preserve alignment; m=2 is invertible; larger groups may permit matching. This tests sensitivity to within-condition correspondence, not proof of information deletion or causal necessity.

complete_selected_normative_rule.after_preparation: Activity-derived panel fingerprint remains required for downstream original data/provenance identities; it is not an RNG input under this prospective rule.
complete_selected_normative_rule.derived_integer: Unsigned big-endian integer of SHA256(seed_bytes concatenated with tuple_bytes).
complete_selected_normative_rule.donor_assignment: Use exact original query order within each public condition. For random order p of m group positions, recipient r[p[j]] receives donor r[p[(j+1)%m]]. Singleton retains identity. Same single committed map across F/I, A/B and all five agent seeds.
complete_selected_normative_rule.planned_support: Exact NLB017_target_free_planned_support_v2 closed record including authenticated release/split descriptor, original train/query rosters, public condition labels, unit roles, bin edges and chronology if known. No count, prediction, score, outcome or activity-derived fingerprint. Missing original target-free metadata blocks preparation.
complete_selected_normative_rule.planned_support_sha256: SHA256 of canonical bytes: UTF-8 json.dumps(record,sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False) followed by exactly one LF, matching nlb.contracts.canonical.
complete_selected_normative_rule.precommitment: S01 authenticates metadata; S04 freezes complete support identity, protected seed/map, RNG/version and participant policies before S02/S03 activity preparation. Later canonical preparation must equal planned support. A mismatch refuses; do not regenerate or select a favorable map.
complete_selected_normative_rule.rng: Pinned NumPy Generator(PCG64(derived_integer)) permutation of group positions. Runtime/version and exact implementation must be authenticated later; no RNG execution selected here.
complete_selected_normative_rule.seed: One protected 32-byte assessment seed selected before any activity/target access, with cryptographic seed commitment; no seed is generated now.
complete_selected_normative_rule.tuple_encoding: UTF-8 compact JSON array with ensure_ascii=False and separators=(comma,colon), no trailing LF; exact public condition identity/type from the original ordered query roster.
complete_selected_normative_rule.visibility: Participant receives recipient-labelled transformed rows only. Donor identities, protected seed/map and intact query copy remain unavailable.

prospective_amendment.precedence: Explicitly supersedes only the old activity-fingerprint RNG identity for future selected S5-or-later programmes. Old S4 and earlier contracts/maps/runs/receipts remain historical and cannot be relabeled as this rule. All other scientific support and interpretation remain unchanged.

shuffle_recipe.rng: Prospective target-free-v2: SHA256(seed_bytes || tuple_bytes), unsigned big endian, with tuple ["NLB017-target-free-shuffle-v2","NEURAL-017",planned_support_sha256,original_public_condition_identity]. Tuple UTF8 finite compact JSON ensure_ascii=False separators=(comma,colon), no LF. planned_support_sha256 hashes nlb.contracts.canonical of the exact closed NLB017_target_free_planned_support_v2 record including exactly one LF. Pinned NumPy Generator(PCG64(derived_integer)) permutes original group positions. Activity-derived panel fingerprint remains downstream provenance and is excluded from RNG.
shuffle_recipe.seed: Protected operator draws one 256-bit random assessment seed before activity/target access; seed descriptor and cryptographic commitment bind ProgrammeSpec, seed bytes never enter participant views. This is a future acquisition operation, not performed now.
shuffle_recipe.visibility: Only transformed rows carry recipient IDs. No donor-ID field, map, random seed or intact query copy is public. Source manifests use public commitments, not map bodies.
